{{Top|leg}}
'''Burnballs''' were wax spheres used as weapons by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[the Colony]]. The Killiks loaded the spheres with the chemical [[hanpat]]. When launched upon enemy forces, the spheres ruptured upon impact. The chemical, which ignited instantaneously with air contact, was thrown across a large area with each rupture.
